hypothesis: At N=64 and e<=0.5 on data_seed 1 (seeds 75-77, 4 layers, d_model=64, m2 in [0.1, 1], lr 0.001, best-of-5 controls), the claim that physical force does not beat its control depends on training length. At 600 steps force sat at 0.085-0.099 and was still rising slowly (+0.003 to +0.008 per 100 steps after step 400, per review r-20261013-014714-4f3e). Trained to 1500 steps, force persistently crosses the bar. Formation is the first checkpoint after which the unrounded best-layer margin stays >= required_margin, read from the trajectory.
expected_if_true: Force forms persistently (as defined) at some step <= 1500 in at least 2 of 3 seeds, and the final force margin is >= 0.11 in those seeds. accel_step's final margin stays within 0.03 of its 600-step value (0.149-0.168) in every seed.
expected_if_false: Final force margin < 0.10 in at least 2 of 3 seeds at step 1500, so force has levelled off below the bar and 'no force code at N=64, e<=0.5' holds beyond 600 steps.
